originalText: {"recordId":"d16aade78f5e7e20517ce87f","country":"DK","sourceId":"DK-buyers","sourceName":"Danish DTU, DMI and climate-data buyer notices","sourceUrl":"https://udbud.dk/detaljevisning?noticeId=a20374c4-dda3-4eea-b09c-d51a5c9cfb2d&noticeVersion=01&noticePublicationNumber=00090528-2026","noticeId":"a20374c4-dda3-4eea-b09c-d51a5c9cfb2d|01","procedureId":"69b1cdfc-3248-4803-9554-b049d853dc1b","title":"A High repetition rate dual-comb tunable OPO with integrated pump laser","description":"DTU requires the delivery of a turnkey, highly stable, and mutually coherent dual-comb light source with a broad spectral tuning range covering the near- to mid-infrared. The system shall be capable of generating femtosecond pulses at high repetition rates.
